string-array.name: descriptions
string-array.item: Clark, a struggling furniture store owner, discovers a glowing portal in his basement that leads to an endless, labyrinthine dimension. After Clark and his associates vanish into the surreal and hostile space, his therapist, Dr. Mary Kline, must venture into the unknown to find him.

Mario, Luigi, and Princess Peach launch into outer space to rescue Princess Rosalina after Bowser Jr. kidnaps her to free his shrunken father, Bowser. Teaming up with Yoshi and Fox McCloud, the group journeys across vibrant cosmic worlds to stop the Koopas from destroying the universe and uncover Peach\'s hidden celestial origins.

A reluctant hobbit named Bilbo Baggins is swept away from his quiet life in the Shire by the wizard Gandalf the Grey. Bilbo joins a company of thirteen dwarves, led by the exiled prince Thorin Oakenshield, on a dangerous quest across Middle-earth to reclaim their lost mountain kingdom of Erebor and its vast treasure from the fearsome dragon, Smaug. Along the way, the group faces trolls, goblins, orcs, and dark magic, and Bilbo encounters the creature Gollum, accidentally acquiring a mysterious gold ring of invisibility that will change the fate of the entire world.

A group of young misfits discover an ancient map and set out on an underground adventure to find a legendary pirate\'s long-lost treasure. Along the way, they race against time to save their homes from foreclosure while dodging a bumbling family of criminals.

Heroes from distinct universes are thrust together as the multiverse collapses. They must form massive alliances to battle Doctor Doom, an enigmatic master of technology and sorcery who poses an existential threat to all reality.

Young noble Paul Atreides moves with his family to the harsh desert planet Arrakis, the universe\'s only source of the valuable resource known as \"spice\". When a betrayal leads to a brutal attack on his family, Paul must navigate political plots and embrace his destiny alongside the planet\'s native Fremen people.

In the summer of 1922, aspiring writer Nick Carraway moves to Long Island next door to the mysterious, self-made millionaire Jay Gatsby. As Nick gets pulled into Gatsby\'s lavish world, he witnesses an obsessive quest to win back his lost love, Daisy Buchanan, which ultimately leads to tragedy.

Harry Potter, Ron Weasley, and Hermione Granger leave Hogwarts to hunt down and destroy Lord Voldemort\'s remaining Horcruxes, the secret to his immortality. As Voldemort\'s forces seize control of the wizarding world, the trio must survive on the run while uncovering the powerful legend of the Deathly Hallows.
The Avengers and the Guardians of the Galaxy unite to stop the intergalactic warlord Thanos from collecting all six Infinity Stones.

Clark Kent strives to reconcile his Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing in Smallville. Working as a reporter for the Daily Planet, he must navigate a world that views heroes with skepticism while facing off against Lex Luthor.

Rey seeks out Luke Skywalker for training in the ways of the Force while the dwindling Resistance flees from an all-out assault by Kylo Ren and the First Order. As Rey attempts to turn Kylo to the light side, Luke makes a final, self-sacrificing stand to help the surviving rebels escape.

In the year 2805, a lonely waste-cleaning robot named WALL-E leaves a deserted, trash-covered Earth to chase a sleek probe named EVE across the galaxy. Their accidental space adventure sparks a mission to save humanity from centuries of lazy consumerism and return life to the planet.
